title: Gladstone has plans

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: Ah, it's you. One of my few real friends down here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, it's you. One of my few real friends down here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There's a few obvious things you could do to make more friends.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's a few obvious things you could do to make more friends.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: There's a few obvious things you could do to make more friends.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: There's a few obvious things you could do to make more friends.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You can't blame people, can you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You can't blame people, can you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You can't blame people, can you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You can't blame people, can you?

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: It will all change once I'm rich and have a residence in the Spire! Then they'll want to know my secret.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It will all change once I'm rich and have a residence in the Spire! Then they'll want to know my secret.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What secret?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What secret?

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: It's all thanks to my new allies.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's all thanks to my new allies.

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: They aren't greedy. Once their belly is full, they are peaceful. They don't hoard!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They aren't greedy. Once their belly is full, they are peaceful. They don't hoard!

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: They don't have to fill fridges, much less bank accounts.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They don't have to fill fridges, much less bank accounts.

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: Did I mention they don't compete with each other?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did I mention they don't compete with each other?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You did.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You did.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Several times!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Several times!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah, I got it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, I got it.

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: They bring me presents, gifts. Small things they find that they cannot eat.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They bring me presents, gifts. Small things they find that they cannot eat.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And what would those be?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And what would those be?

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: Rings, pearls, earrings, small jewelry. Worth hundreds of Lims, every day. Incredible what people flush down their toilets.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Rings, pearls, earrings, small jewelry. Worth hundreds of Lims, every day. Incredible what people flush down their toilets.

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: My friends have no use for vanity.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My friends have no use for vanity.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Indigestible rubbish?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Indigestible rubbish?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And you want to use this treasure to make your way to the Spire?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you want to use this treasure to make your way to the Spire?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And you want to use this treasure to make your way to the Spire?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And you want to use this treasure to make your way to the Spire?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If you've made some money maybe you could improve your life HERE?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you've made some money maybe you could improve your life HERE?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If you've made some money maybe you could improve your life HERE?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If you've made some money maybe you could improve your life HERE?

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: Why should I? To impress people I don't like, and who don't like me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why should I? To impress people I don't like, and who don't like me?

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: The rats don't judge me like that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The rats don't judge me like that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why do you want to live in the Spire?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why do you want to live in the Spire?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why do you want to live in the Spire?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why do you want to live in the Spire?

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: I didn't say I'd live there. I said I'd have a RESIDENCE there. I just want Spire dwellers looking at me in confusion, their noses wrinkling, their skin crawling.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I didn't say I'd live there. I said I'd have a RESIDENCE there. I just want Spire dwellers looking at me in confusion, their noses wrinkling, their skin crawling.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's hilarious. I love it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's hilarious. I love it.

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: I'd show up there from time to time, bring some friends. Make a real scene. It could be quite amusing. What do you think?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd show up there from time to time, bring some friends. Make a real scene. It could be quite amusing. What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That seems like a bad idea.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That seems like a bad idea.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That seems like a bad idea.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That seems like a bad idea.

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: I need to go make some plans. I'm going to arrange a little excursion for next week. I'll see you around!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need to go make some plans. I'm going to arrange a little excursion for next week. I'll see you around!
